_handoff.scope: Public-workflow pass for the DEFAULT new residential water-supply and underground-drainage connection path in Bengaluru. Only unauthenticated BWSSB public pages were inspected. No phone number, OTP, application number, property identifier, document, payment, grievance, or submission was entered.
_handoff.observationNote: Direct public-interface observations are Grade B. Login, payment, upload, submission, case lookup, inspection outcome, demand-note state, and RR-number state remain Unknown. The current consumer page uses mobile OTP; the public FAQ and register page also expose an older email/password SAJALA route, which is retained as a currentness boundary rather than assumed to be the same live path.

claims.text: The current BWSSB Jaladhare consumer page exposes a Mobile Number input, Send OTP control, Enter OTP input, Submit control, an application-number input with Submit for status, and a Show All Application link.
claims.notes: Exact visible labels: “Mobile Number”, “Send OTP”, “Enter OTP”, “Submit”, “Enter Your Application number to know the status”, and “Show All Application”. No value was entered or control activated.

claims.text: The current public page instructs a new-connection applicant to log in with a mobile number, provide a proper email ID and mobile phone number, make payment to buy the Application form, fill required details and upload documents, and use the same mobile number to know application status.
claims.notes: High-level public wording only; it does not establish a current authenticated transition, eligibility, or case outcome.

claims.text: The current public page lists lease cum sale deed or sale deed, Khata certificate, Building Plan / Sanction Plan, photographs of building with owner, and an RWH adoption document for premises measuring 1200sqft and above under Documents required.
claims.notes: This is the public checklist text, not proof that every item is required for this particular property or that a selected upload would be accepted.

claims.text: The current public status section displays “Permission for new Connection/Additional Connection for water supply and under Ground Drainage” and headings of “Residential Connections 14 days” and “Commercial and High Rise Connections 42 days”.
claims.notes: The page displays Application Status As on : 30-08-2026. Metrics are blank in the public view; the clock-start event and any guarantee are not stated.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ says that if the transaction fails while buying a new application and the amount is deducted, the payment-gateway merchant will refund the amount in a very short time.
claims.notes: Published FAQ recovery wording, not a live transaction observation. No payment page was opened.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ says fields marked with (*) are mandatory, an application can be saved as a draft and edited later, and a confirmed application cannot be edited until it is received back from AEE for updates.
claims.notes: Published guidance; the current mobile-OTP form and its exact live field set were not opened.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ says ward number and service area determine automatic routing to the concerned sub-division AEE; if selected incorrectly, the receiving AEE may correct them or send the application back to the applicant to correct and re-submit/re-confirm.
claims.notes: Published correction route; no application was created or routed.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ says engineers can message through an Inbox or call the registered number, and an AE/JE will call and inform the applicant in advance about an inspection visit to the connection address.
claims.notes: Published guidance; no case, call, Inbox message, inspection, or finding was observed.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ says the plumber must be BWSSB-registered, plumber details may be changed before final payment, and a scanned consumer/registered-plumber agreement must be attached before final payment.
claims.notes: Published guidance; the public Plumber List link was visible on the consumer page, but no selection or agreement upload was performed.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ says that after AE/JE inspection, charges such as prorata and GBWASP are calculated and a demand note with a parameter breakdown and total is raised; after AEE approval an SMS asks the applicant to log in, the demand note is available in payment history, online final payment is then made, and an e-receipt is generated after successful payment.
claims.notes: Published sequence only; no inspection, demand note, SMS, payment, or receipt was observed.

claims.text: The current consumer page visibly includes the notice: “Extention of Demand Note Validity : Please note that all demand notes cancelled since 03-05-2021 will be valid upto 31-07-2021.”
claims.notes: This is visibly stale relative to the 2026 page date and is not treated as a current validity rule or recovery promise.

claims.text: The public SAJALA register page visibly labels Buy New Application, Verify Application, Track your application, Payment to BWSSB, Approve Application, and Generated RR Number, and displays “Form validation error.” and “Form validation successful.”.
claims.notes: These are visible labels/states on an unauthenticated registration page, not a triggered application error or proof that the older email/password route is the current mobile-OTP journey.

claims.text: The public BWSSB grievance page exposes Consumer Name, Consumer Mobile No, Subject, Application Number, Application Name, Address, Plumber Name, Remarks, and Submit; it displays Mail Us: eerbc@bwssb.gov.in and Toll Free : 1916.
claims.notes: Public recovery surface only; no field was populated and no grievance was submitted, acknowledged, routed, or answered.

claims.text: BWSSB's FAQ publishes owcenquiry@bwssb.org and call centre number 080 22238888 for more queries.
claims.notes: Published contact route; no contact was made.

claims.text: The public pass did not establish eligibility, current property-field validation, document acceptance, inspection result, demand-note issuance or amount, payment state, application stage, or RR-number generation for any particular property.
claims.notes: No login, OTP, payment, upload, submission, application-number lookup, inspection, or grievance submission was attempted.

journeyBoundary.observedPublicPath: Current page -> mobile-number/OTP controls -> high-level instruction to pay for the application -> fill details/upload documents -> same-mobile-number status lookup; public FAQ/register pages additionally describe older SAJALA stages.
